acceptanceCriteria: A clean immutable candidate passes the full, companion and installed gates selected for the alpha.

A candidate-bound alpha readiness report permits only owner-accepted native-performance NOT_RUN and treats tagging, publication and promotion as subsequent owner actions; the current strict release-checklist exit status is not used as an executable gate.
Extracted artifacts reproduce the documented workflow and release notes match every experimental or unsupported surface.
Tagging and publication occur only after owner approval of the exact candidate; publication does not imply promotion.
body: Cut the honest public-alpha baseline after scope, inventory, blockers, installed qualification and host status are settled. Hosted CI is passed, explicitly nonblocking by accepted decision, or remains a visible blocker.
title: Cut and publish the honest 0.4.0a5 alpha
